title: 第11章  进山前的一夜
slug: 四合院开局绑定空间农场
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

拾掇完头脸，李阳折回灶房。

就瞅见秦淮茹立在面缸前头，偏过脸问他：“李阳，你这儿粮食还存了不少嘛。”

“姐，那是我一口一口从牙缝里抠出来的嚼谷。”李阳张嘴就解释，“我每回下乡，全指着这点东西填肚子。”

这娘们儿还没歇了心思，老琢磨着从他手里再抠点啥走。

秦淮茹拿手拨拉着缸里的棒子面，嘀咕道：“这么些个棒子面，你一个人吃到啥时候去？”

“咋就吃不完？我每回下乡，翻山越岭走村串户，腿都跑细了。”李阳拽了把凳子坐下，“可不比你们家贾东旭蹲车间里轻省，饭量比窝在城里时大了去了。”

见秦淮茹还拿眼瞟那面缸，李阳又撂了一句：“甭瞅了。应了你五斤带回去，已经是割我的肉了，再多一撮也甭想。”

秦淮茹肚子里叹了口气。李阳这话说得死硬死硬的，再磨也没啥意思。

家里没吃的是实情，可饿上几顿又能咋的？让贾东旭自个儿想法子去。

窝头上了汽，不多时就蒸透了。

秦淮茹拢共捏了六个，自个儿留了俩，剩下四个全推到李阳跟前。

“要不你再来一个？”李阳跟她打商量。这窝头蒸得糙拉拉的，嚼在嘴里直刮嗓子眼。

秦淮茹摇摇头，笑了一下：“算你有这份心。你多吃些，才有力气在外头跑。”

她也是打乡里出去的，知道在村与村之间爬坡过坎有多费腿脚，那可不是闹着玩的。

李阳犹豫了一下，还是掰了一个窝头递过去。

“你再垫一个。我今儿不走远道，少吃一口不打紧。”

秦淮茹鼻子一酸，眼眶子热了，没再往外推，嗯了一声接过窝头，小口小口地啃。

吃饭这当口，两个人各自揣着心事，谁也没开腔。

秦淮茹心里头七上八下的，想着等会儿回了娘家，拿啥脸去见爹娘和叔伯。好些年不登门，空着手回去也就罢了，还想从人家嘴里往外掏粮食，这话说出去都嫌寒碜。

要不是贾张氏成天在家骂骂咧咧，逼着她回来讨粮，她是宁死也不愿走这一遭的。

李阳这边呢，心里头在盘算今儿个要不要进山撵些野物。

昨儿后半夜又落了一场雪，外头的雪窝子更深了。山道上不好走，想打着东西怕是不容易。

再说山边边上的野物早叫人搜刮得干干净净。就算进了山，怕也得往深里走老远，钻到老林子肚里去，才有点盼头。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After cleaning up, Li Yang returned to the kitchen.

He saw Qin Huairu standing in front of the noodle vat, turned her face and asked him: "Li Yang, you still have a lot of food here."

"Sister, that's the chewed grain I dug out from between my teeth bit by bit." Li Yang opened his mouth and explained, "Every time I go to the countryside, I always point to this stuff to fill my stomach."

This bitch hasn't stopped thinking yet, she's always thinking about grabbing something else from his hand.

Qin Huairu pulled the stick noodles in the jar with her hand and muttered: "How long will you be able to eat these stick noodles by yourself?"

"Why can't I finish eating? Every time I go to the countryside and go from village to village, my legs are thin." Li Yang pulled a stool and sat down, "It's not as easy as your Jia Dongxu squatting in the workshop, and his appetite is bigger than when he stayed in the city."

Seeing that Qin Huairu was still glancing at the vat, Li Yang said again: "Don't look at it. I promised you five pounds to take back, and you've already cut off my flesh. Don't even think about adding another handful."

Qin Huairu sighed in his stomach.Li Yang said this so stubbornly that it would be meaningless to grind on it.

It’s true that there’s nothing to eat at home, but what’s the point of being hungry for a few meals?Let Jia Dongxu find his own way.

The steamed buns were filled with steam, and soon they were completely steamed.

Qin Huairu pinched six in total, kept two for himself, and pushed the remaining four to Li Yang.

"How about you do another one?" Li Yang discussed with her.This steamed steamed bun is so rough that it scratches your throat when you chew it.

Qin Huairu shook her head and smiled: "You have such a heart. Eat more so that you have the strength to run outside."

She also came from the countryside and knew how taxing her legs were to climb uphill and over obstacles between villages. It was no joke.

Li Yang hesitated for a moment, then broke off a steamed bun and handed it over.

"You can add another one. I won't go far today. It doesn't matter if I miss one bite."

Qin Huairu's nose felt sore and her eyes were hot. She didn't push it out anymore. She took the bun with a hum and nibbled it in small bites.

While eating, the two of them were keeping their own thoughts and no one said anything.

Qin Huairu was anxious, thinking about how she would face her parents and uncle when she returned to her parents' home later.It's been years since I've been home, so I just want to go back empty-handed. I still want to take food out of people's mouths. This is a shameful thing to say.

If Mrs. Jia Zhang hadn't been scolding her at home all day long, forcing her to come back to beg for food, she would rather die than go through this life.

Li Yang, on his side, was thinking about whether he should go into the mountains to catch some wild animals today.

It snowed again in the middle of the night last night, and the snow outside became deeper.The mountain road is not easy to walk on, so it may be difficult to catch something.

Besides, the wild animals on the edge of the mountain have been plundered cleanly.Even if I enter the mountains, I'm afraid I have to go all the way deep into the old forest before I can have any hope.
